svg.title: One listener on the container. Four outcomes on every fetch.
svg.desc: A DOM tree from body down to three list items with the listener drawn on the ul, a dashed capture arrow going down the left and a solid bubble arrow coming back up the right, and a fourth dashed list item added later that is already handled. Beside it a two-by-two state box for loading, empty, error and success, and bars comparing ways of building 50 000 rows from innerHTML in a loop at roughly 309 seconds down to a virtualized 30 rows at 0.3 milliseconds.
